Lu Chui invokes our house’s Pingyuan visiting Zhang Zhuangwu as a literary precedent for Liu Xian’s learned exchange. Songshu081 explicitly supplies Jin Pingyuan Interior Governor Lu Ji. This connects the title allusion; 吾家 is retained only at its stated broad kinship level.

However, unlike the military or named-work bridges, the sealed packet gives no independently identifying office, courtesy name, date or linked work for this isolated remark; exact full name plus generic authorship alone is insufficient for a confident merge. Preserve this pair as possible-same-as pending a source bridge.

findings.finding: The sealed source supplies an isolated full-name attribution of a scholarly remark. The author calls it the same Jin writer but cites no office, courtesy-name, family, era, named-work or repeated-quote bridge connecting this attribution to the target. Rejecting a new Northern Wei contemporary does not establish which earlier namesake is meant. The unsupported AD289 metadata cannot supply the missing bridge. My pre-exposure judgment remains possible-same-as; the exact high-confidence 32-member merge is not approved.
